meta.name: Software Engineer Skill Tree
meta.purpose: An explorable, game-like skill tree for junior engineers to discover what to learn next and progressively develop broader, deeper and higher-impact engineering capability.
principles: Prefer demonstrable abilities over topic labels.
Seniority emerges from combinations of skills, scope, autonomy, ambiguity and impact rather than a single linear path.
A skill may unlock multiple future paths.
Capability milestones combine skills from multiple categories.
Learning resources are references, not prerequisites.
Commercial or affiliate links can be added later without changing the skill graph.

tier_meanings.1: Foundation — can perform with clear scope and guidance.
tier_meanings.2: Independent — can handle common work independently.
tier_meanings.3: Ownership — can own an area, reason about trade-offs and handle ambiguity.
tier_meanings.4: System/leadership — can design, operate, influence and improve beyond a single task.
